market_question: Will PSG win the 2025–26 Champions League?
reasoning: No single club has a >50% chance to win the Champions League before the season starts; historical pre‑season favourites rarely exceed 20% implied probability. PSG are a strong side but the field includes multiple top‑tier rivals, and 58.5% is an extreme overvaluation of their title chances. True likelihood is closer to 10‑12%, making ‘No’ the clear value.
evidence_points: Pre‑season UCL winner odds for the most favoured club typically imply 15‑20% at most, not 58%.
PSG have never won the Champions League and have under‑performed in recent knockout stages.
Squad composition and managerial stability for 2025‑26 are not yet finalised, adding uncertainty.
Even in a hypothetical best‑case scenario, PSG’s true win probability is roughly one‑fifth of the market’s current implied probability.
sources_consulted: Historical UEFA Champions League betting odds
